bio.text: Ashley Bell is a Democratic candidate for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District in 2026.

According to her campaign website, she is a physician associate who has worked in emergency medicine, primary care, rural clinics and telemedicine, and has taught evidence-based medicine and research at the master's and doctoral level.

The site says she was raised in rural East Texas, earned her physician associate credentials at Wake Forest School of Medicine and a Doctor of Medical Science from the University of Lynchburg, and lives in the Triad.
